Package IoTFleetManagement.agent.controller

Klasse AgentController

java.lang.Object
IoTFleetManagement.agent.controller.AgentController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/agents") public class AgentController extends Object
Controller class for managing IoT Agents in the fleet management system.

This class provides REST API endpoints to manage IoT agents, including adding new agents, retrieving their status, and updating their online status.

Autor:
Lara, Jasmin1707, Miriam

    • assignFirmwareToAgent

      @PutMapping("/{agentId}/firmware/{firmwareId}") public Agent assignFirmwareToAgent(@PathVariable("agentId") Long agentId, @PathVariable("firmwareId") Long firmwareId)
      Assigns a firmware version to a specific agent.

      This endpoint allows associating a firmware identified by its ID with an agent identified by its ID. It updates the agent's record to reflect the assigned firmware version.

      Endpoint: PUT /{agentId}/firmware/{firmwareId}

      Parameter:
      agentId - the unique identifier of the agent to which the firmware will be assigned
      firmwareId - the unique identifier of the firmware to be assigned to the agent
      Gibt zurück:
      the updated Agent object reflecting the assigned firmware

    • applyActionToAgents

      @PostMapping("/apply-action") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> applyActionToAgents(@RequestBody Map<String,Object> request)
      Endpoint to check if a firmware update is required for a given agent.

      This endpoint retrieves the latest firmware version from the system and compares it with the firmware version currently associated with the specified agent. If the agent's firmware version is either null or does not match the latest version, an update is deemed required, and the response includes the URL for the latest firmware.

      Gibt zurück:
      a ResponseEntity containing a map with the following keys: status: "updateRequired" if an update is needed, "noUpdate" otherwise. url: the URL of the latest firmware if an update is required, or null otherwise. In case of an error, the response includes an error message and an HTTP 500 status.
      Löst aus:
      RuntimeException - if the agent with the given ID is not found.

    • checkForFirmwareUpdate

      @GetMapping("/{agentId}/update-check") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> checkForFirmwareUpdate(@PathVariable("agentId") String agentId)
      Endpoint to check if a firmware update is required for a given agent.

      This endpoint retrieves the latest firmware version from the system and compares it with the firmware version currently associated with the specified agent. If the agent's firmware version is either null or does not match the latest version, an update is deemed required, and the response includes the URL for the latest firmware.

      Parameter:
      agentId - the unique identifier of the agent whose firmware update status is to be checked
      Gibt zurück:
      a ResponseEntity containing a map with the following keys: status: "updateRequired" if an update is needed, "noUpdate" otherwise. url: the URL of the latest firmware if an update is required, or null otherwise. In case of an error, the response includes an error message and an HTTP 500 status.
      Löst aus:
      RuntimeException - if the agent with the given ID is not found.
